name: Hengeyokai (Far Distant Future Publishing)
body:
The hengeyokai are magical shapeshifting creatures able to shift between human and animal forms.

Physical

A hengeyokai’s natural form resembles a bipedal, animalistic humanoid. Several varieties exist, each defined by the kind of animal form they can assume. While hengeyokai of a particular type do tend to stick together, these animal forms are not strictly hereditary, and their offspring may be a completely different type.

When assuming animal or human form, a hengeyokai always assumes the same appearance, which usually reflects elements of their hybrid form.

In their natural form, each hengeyokai is actually a combination of these two forms—a bipedal “hybrid” that is half-way between animal and human. They stand on their hind legs, usually to the full height of their human form. Their front appendages—whether wings, paws, fins, or claws—change into hands with opposable thumbs that can hold weapons and manipulate tools. The rest of their body retains the overall shape of a human, but the fur, feathers, chitin, or other characteristic covering and coloration of the animal. While in their hybrid form, they do not have a tail, wings, horns, pedipalps, or other features not typical of humans.

Most hengeyokai resemble a small mammal, such as a badger, cat, dog, hare, or monkey.

Several less common varieties, including those based on birds, fish, and arthropods, have also been attested, and are described below. Hengeyokai based on other animals have been rumored, including crayfish, dolphin, frog, mantis, sparrow, and tiger hengeyokai; however, no evidence of these hengeyokai heritages has ever been shown, and they are most likely cases of mistaken identity or overactive imaginations.

Social

Hengeyokai are typically found on the fringes of human-settled lands, where they can mingle in human form but retreat to solitude when desired. They typically live alone or in small groups, and carefully keep to themselves so as not to reveal their true nature, especially among humans. Although hengeyokai enjoy the presence of humans, in their experience they have found that revealing their true nature to them has only led to persecution and problems.

It is believed that all hengeyokai display personality traits reminiscent of their animal type; thus, dog hengeyokai are said to be loyal and protective, while cat hengeyokai are secretive and aloof. However, while some trends may be noted, individual hengeyokai are as varied in their outlooks as any other species.

If there is one unifying trait to hengeyokai society, it is their deep, spiritual connection to nature. Hengeyokai often assume a protective role over a natural space that they consider sacred. Many will also adopt a protective stance toward a nearby human community, although some instead become hostile toward these humans if they feel that the humans have not respected the natural order.

Hengeyokai believe themselves to be closer to the spirit world than humans, and therefore feel a close affinity for the kami-bound. They also appreciate koropokkuru for their love of nature, although the isolationist nature of both species mean that they rarely come into contact.

Alignment and Religion

Hengeyokai are extremely varied in their alignment, although some animal types have a tendency toward certain alignment profiles. (Dog hengeyokai tend toward Lawful, and cat hengeyokai toward Chaotic, for example.) Overall they are split on the Lawful-Chaotic divide, while more tend toward Good than Evil.

Hengeyokai culture places a strong emphasis on spirituality, although they rarely reach fervent levels of devotion or gain levels in divine spellcasting classes.

Unlike their human neighbors, hengeyokai shamans do not worship the spirits of nature, as they consider themselves these spirits equals—they command the power of the spirits not through supplication, but through partnership. The most common spiritual practice for hengeyokai is to study a monastic or philosophical doctrine.

Note: The hengeyokai as presented here is suggested as an alternative to the original version presented on page 8 of In the Company of Henge by Rite Publishing.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers Your ability score adjustments vary depending on your heritage (see below) [standard].
Size In your hybrid and human forms, you are a Medium creature, and you have no bonuses or penalties due to size.
Type You are a Fey with the shapechanger subtype.
Speed In your hybrid and human forms, your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Celestial, Draconic, Goblin, Koropokkuru, Samsaran, and Tengu.
Alternate Traits
Cold Iron Vulnerability You are susceptible to cold iron. Weapons of this type always do +1 damage against you and overcome any DR/magic you might have. Moreover, if you are in one of your alternative forms when struck for damage (lethal or nonlethal) with a cold iron object, you revert instantly to your true (hybrid) form.
Fey Skills Stealth and Survival are always class skills for you.
Heritage As a hengeyokai, you must choose an animal heritage, which determines your ability score adjustments and grants you additional species traits, known as your hengeyokai talents (see below).
Keen Senses You receive a +2 species bonus to Perception checks.
Low-Light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.
Change Shape (Su) You can change your shape to assume one of three possible forms: animal, human, or hybrid. Your hybrid form is your natural form, and you can return to this shape as desired. You can change into one of the other two forms a maximum number of times per day equal to 1/2 your character level (minimum 1). Changing form is a ? full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Your appearance in each form is static: you will always have the same, recognizable features each time you assume a given form. Your animal form is a normal animal of Small or Tiny size. Changing into this form works as beast shape II, except that you always take the form of the same, specific animal and can maintain this form indefinitely. You gain a +1 natural armor bonus while in animal form. If your animal form is Small, you gain a +2 Dexterity bonus while in this form. If it is Tiny, you have a +4 Dexterity bonus and a –2 Strength penalty. Your ability scores and statistics otherwise remain unchanged while in animal form. In animal form, you are effectively disguised as an animal; you gain a +10 species bonus on Disguise checks to appear as this animal while in this form, and take no penalties on your Disguise check for being a creature of a different type. In human form, this ability functions as alter self except that you always take the same, specific human form, can remain in this form indefinitely, and your ability scores remain unchanged from your natural (hybrid) form. You gain a +10 species bonus on Disguise checks made to appear human while in this form, and take no penalties on your Disguise check for being a creature of a different type.
Hengeyokai Heritages
Badger Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Cha.

Animal Form As a badger, you are a Small animal (+1 natural armor, +2 Dexterity).

Speed Your movement rate is 30 feet. You have a bite attack (1d4) and two claw attacks (1d3). While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Heal and Knowledge (religion) checks.

Carp Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Wis, –2 Int.

Animal Form As a carp, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). You have a 5 ft. land speed, but cannot use this speed to make a 5-foot step.

Swim You also gain a 50 ft. swim speed and a bite attack (1d3). While in animal form, you can only breathe water; out of water, you can hold your breath in air for a number of rounds equal to twice your Constitution score, after which you begin to suffocate.

Hengeyokai Talents In your hybrid form only, you gain a swim speed of 20 ft., as well as the amphibious special ability (allowing you to breathe in water or in air).

Cat Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a cat, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 30 feet.

Claws You have two claw attacks (1d2) and a bite attack (1d3). While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

Crab Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Int.

Animal Form As a crab, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 30 feet, and you gain a swim speed of 20 feet. While in animal form, you have darkvision 60 ft. and two claw attacks (1d2 damage each). While in animal form, you are water-dependent; you can breathe in water without problem, but can only exist out of water for a number of hours equal to half your Constitution score, after which you begin to suffocate.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (nature) checks and to grapple combat maneuver checks.

Crane Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Int, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a crane, you are a Small animal (+1 natural armor, +2 Dexterity).

Speed Your movement rate is 15 feet.

Fly You gain a fly speed of 40 feet (average). While in animal form, you have a bite attack (1d4 damage).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (religion) checks.

Dog Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Int.

Animal Form As a dog, you are a Small animal (+1 natural armor, +2 Dexterity).

Speed Your movement rate is 40 feet.

Bite You have a bite attack (1d4 damage).

Scent While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Sense Motive and Survival checks.

Duck Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a duck, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 10 feet, and you gain a swim speed of 20 feet, and a fly speed of 30 feet (average). While in animal form, you have a bite attack (1d3 damage).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +4 species bonus to Swim checks and can always take 10 on such checks. In addition, you gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (nature) checks, and Knowledge (nature) is a class skill for you.

Fox Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a fox, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 40 feet, and you have a bite attack (1d3 damage). While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (local) and Stealth checks.

Hare Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a hare, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 50 feet, and you have a bite attack (1d3).

Hengeyokai Talents While in human or hybrid form, not wearing heavy armor, and not carrying a heavy load, your base movement rate increases by +10 feet. (This stacks with other abilities that increase your speed, such as the barbarian’s fast movement class feature.) Additionally, you are always proficient in the use of the spear, longbow, and shortbow (including composite bows), and you treat the horse bow MM as a martial weapon instead of an exotic one.

Lizard Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Str, +2 Wis, –2 Int.

Animal Form As a lizard, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 20 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 20 feet. While in animal form, you have a bite attack (1d3 damage).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Escape Artist and Survival checks.

Monkey Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a monkey, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 30 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 30 feet. You have a bite attack (1d3). As a monkey, you have hands, but can only manipulate tools and weapons sized for Tiny creatures.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Acrobatics checks. In addition, you gain a climb speed of 20 feet while in your hybrid form (but not your human form).

Otter Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As an otter, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 20 feet, and you gain a swim speed of 30 feet. You have a bite attack (1d3).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Acrobatics and Disable Device skill checks.

Panda Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Wis, –2 Cha.

Animal Form As a red panda, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 20 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 20 feet. While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability and a bite attack (1d3 damage).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (religion) and Stealth checks.

Raccoon-Dog Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a raccoon-dog, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 40 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 10 feet. You have a bite attack (1d3).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Disable Device and Stealth skill checks.

Rat Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Wis, –2 Cha.

Animal Form As a rat, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 15 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 15 feet and a swim speed of 15 feet. While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability and a bite attack (1d3 damage).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (nature) and Stealth checks.

Spider Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Cha.

Animal Form As a spider, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 20 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 20 feet. While in animal form, you have darkvision 60 ft., a bite attack (1d3 damage), and a +12 bonus to your CMD vs. trip maneuvers. Unlike most actual spiders, you do not have a web attack or any kind of venom.

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

Weasel Hengeyokai

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Wis.

Animal Form As a weasel, you are a Tiny animal (+1 natural armor, +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength). Your movement rate is 20 feet, and you gain a climb speed of 20 feet. While in animal form, you have the scent universal monster ability and a bite attack (1d3 damage).

Hengeyokai Talents You gain a +2 species bonus to Acrobatics and Knowledge (local) checks.

Alternate Species Traits
Fey Envoy You are well versed at interacting with humans and others of different backgrounds. You gain a +2 species bonus to Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks. This trait replaces all hengeyokai talents (but not any other features) gained from your hengeyokai heritage.
Limited Shapechanger Choose either your animal form or your human form. You can adopt the chosen form at will, any number of times per day. However, you can never adopt the other form. This trait alters change shape.
Natural Hunter You are gifted at getting along in the wilderness. You gain a +2 species bonus to Stealth and Survival checks. This trait replaces all hengeyokai talents (but not any other features) gained from your hengeyokai heritage.
Oni Foe Oni are the enemy of the hengeyokai, and you have trained hard to fight against these foes. You gain a +2 dodge bonus to your AC against creatures with the oni subtype, as well as a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made against such creatures. This trait replaces keen senses.
Size Small. Your natural (hybrid) form is closer to your animal form in size than most hengeyokai. You are size Small when in your hybrid form; your human form remains size Medium. This trait alters size.
Spirit Scholar You have learned much of the ways of the spirits, and the esoteric knowledge of the fey. You gain a +2 species bonus to Knowledge (nature) and Knowledge (religion) checks. This trait replaces all hengeyokai talents (but not any other features) gained from your hengeyokai heritage.
Wild Magic You can use pass without a trace and speak with animals once per day each as spell-like abilities. The caster level is your character level, and Charisma is your casting ability. This trait replaces keens senses.
